name: Fillmore Minneapolis presented by Affinity Plus

bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12” x 6” x 12” are allowed in the venue and will be searched prior to entry. Non-clear bags will undergo additional searches.
prohibited: professional photo, video, or audio recording equipment
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: The Fillmore Minneapolis does not have its own parking lot but is conveniently located near the Target Field station light rail stop. Metered parking is available on surrounding streets, and several parking ramps are a few blocks away. Parking can be booked through ParkWhiz for convenience.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Fillmore Minneapolis presented by Affinity Plus's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The Fillmore Minneapolis offers a preshow dining experience at Trax Burgers & Bar, featuring craft burgers, appetizers, salads, cocktails, a wide beer selection, and desserts. The venue is fully cashless, accepting major credit cards for all purchases.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Assistive Listening Devices are available for all events.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Fillmore Minneapolis presented by Affinity Plus's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Fillmore Minneapolis presented by Affinity Plus. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Fillmore Minneapolis presented by Affinity Plus. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
